name: Counting and Vectors
description: Count choices without listing them, then meet vectors as arrows you can add and scale.

lessonNames.l7-what-you-do-not-want: Counting what you do not want

lessonObjectives.l1-choices-multiply: Count the outcomes of several choices in a row with the product rule.
lessonObjectives.l2-arranging: Count arrangements of distinct items with factorials.
lessonObjectives.l3-choosing-in-order: Count ordered selections and write them with factorials.
lessonObjectives.l4-choosing-without-order: Count unordered selections and see why we divide by $r!$.
lessonObjectives.l5-repeats: Count arrangements of letters when some letters repeat.
lessonObjectives.l6-together-or-apart: Count arrangements with items kept together or kept apart.
lessonObjectives.l7-what-you-do-not-want: Count by subtracting the unwanted cases from the total.
lessonObjectives.l8-counts-to-chances: Turn counts into probabilities when every outcome is equally likely.
lessonObjectives.l9-arrows: Represent a displacement as a column vector.
lessonObjectives.l10-adding-arrows: Add vectors tip to tail and multiply them by scalars.
lessonObjectives.l11-how-long: Find the magnitude and direction of a vector with Pythagoras.
lessonObjectives.l12-proving-with-vectors: Use vectors to show that points lie on a line or that lines are parallel.
lessonObjectives.l13-portfolio-vector: Represent holdings as a vector, then scale and combine portfolios.
